provider.detail: Frozen venue observations carried in a PMXT-compatible market contract.

selectionMethod: Preserves the eight precise Polymarket situations observed on 2026-08-27, then appends 25 Kalshi Browse cards shown under Trending/Open and 17 non-duplicate Polymarket home-page cards shown under All markets / 24hr Volume / All / Active. rankWithinSource records source-page order and is only an engagement proxy.
volumeBoundary: Every appended numeric volume is the card's separate Vol. value and is encoded as cumulative_event_volume. Polymarket's 24hr Volume setting determines card order only; no appended cumulative volume is relabeled as 24-hour volume.
scientificBoundary: These are dated observations of prediction-market listings, not a live feed. Displayed probabilities and abbreviated Polymarket volumes may be rounded. Open interest and unique bettor/person counts were not exposed on the captured cards and remain null. Trader profiles and actions in the Backer field are modeled.
